APPLICATION_NUMBER.transformation: strip whitespace, preserve string formatting, validate uniqueness

PUBLICATION_NUMBER.transformation: strip whitespace, preserve journal issue format

TITLE_OF_INVENTION.transformation: Unicode NFKC normalization, strip outer quotes and trailing punctuation, preserve scientific symbols, collapse whitespace

FIELD_OF_INVENTION.transformation: standardize uppercase, fill missing with 'UNCATEGORIZED', set field_imputed flag

IPO_LOCATION.transformation: normalize to title case ('Delhi', 'Chennai', 'Kolkata', 'Mumbai'), derive ipo_code

NO_OF_PAGES.transformation: cast to nullable Int64, generate field-median imputed variant

NO_OF_CLAIMS.transformation: cast to nullable Int64, generate field-median imputed variant and claims_range
